bahrain.title: US Ambassador says all drones were intercepted, rejecting IRGC claims
bahrain.summary: US Ambassador Stephanie Hallett called claims by Iran's Revolutionary Guard Corps false, saying every drone was intercepted and that there was no damage and no one was hurt.

bahrain.title: GCC asks UN Security Council to list the Houthis as a terrorist group
bahrain.summary: Speaking for the GCC states, Bahrain urged the UN Security Council to designate the Houthis a terrorist group, saying Gulf security is indivisible and the states keep the right to self-defence.

bahrain.title: Health council and Bahrain Chamber prepare employers for residents' health insurance
bahrain.summary: The Supreme Council for Health and the Bahrain Chamber discussed rolling out the National Health Insurance Programme for Residents, focusing on making employers aware of its requirements, registration steps and coverage, and getting the private sector ready.

bahrain.title: Crown Prince meets President Macron in Paris
bahrain.summary: HRH Prince Salman bin Hamad Al Khalifa, Crown Prince and Prime Minister, met French President Emmanuel Macron in Paris and stressed the long-standing ties between Bahrain and France, which continue to expand across many fields.

bahrain.title: Ministry calls GCC Railway a strategic project for passengers and freight
bahrain.summary: A senior Transportation Ministry official said the GCC Railway Project would improve links between Gulf states, develop passenger and freight transport and make logistics more efficient, which matters for trade and travel to and from Bahrain.

bahrain.title: Bank ABC Islamic nine-month profit falls to $21.8 million
bahrain.summary: Bank ABC Islamic reported net profit of $21.8 million for the first nine months of 2026, down from about $39 million in the same period a year earlier.

crypto.title: Bitcoin drops below $63,000 and XRP hits its lowest level in two years
crypto.summary: According to the headlines, Bitcoin fell to a three-month low under $63,000 as an analyst flagged a fourth capitulation wave, while XRP slid to its lowest since November 2024 as money leaves crypto.

crypto.title: Metaplanet swings to a $170 million loss after selling and rebuying Bitcoin
crypto.summary: Japan's Metaplanet lost about $170 million in nine months, including a $119.8 million loss on selling 10,000 BTC to show lenders it can raise cash. It then bought 11,000 BTC at a higher price, its credit line debt rose to $649.5 million, and MSCI will drop it from its indexes on 30 November.

crypto.title: Kava Lend hacked for about $3.8 million
crypto.summary: According to the headline, the Kava Lend protocol lost roughly $3.8 million to a hack, sending the KAVA token down nearly 40%.

crypto.title: UK, Singapore and Thailand central banks test cross-border FX settlement
crypto.summary: According to the headlines, the three central banks completed a foreign exchange settlement trial linking traditional and tokenized systems, as stablecoins gain ground in cross-border payments.

crypto.title: Indian exchange Unocoin keeps deposits and withdrawals frozen after breach
crypto.summary: Unocoin is still halting deposits and withdrawals while it investigates unauthorised transfers from an Ethereum address tied to its BitGo wallets. BitGo said the transfers were signed with keys Unocoin held and that its own systems were not breached.

crypto.title: Real-world asset protocol stUSDT is shutting down
crypto.summary: stUSDT, which peaked at $2.3 billion locked in 2023 and now holds about $8.6 million, stopped paying interest on Saturday and gives holders until 14 May 2027 to redeem. It gave no reason but says assets remain fully backed. It is not linked to Tether.
